conditional_world.primary_estimand: naive true-state error minus robust true-state error

independent_unit: seed within a declared scenario or rate cell

precision_plan.replication_unit: seed-level contrast with trials nested within seed/cell

primary_estimand: seed-level robust minus naive true-state mass within each declared cell

seed_schedule.independence_boundary: seed streams are deterministic and disjoint within cells; design cells are not assumed independent
seed_schedule.rate_seed_schedule: existing onset schedule rate_component_seed .. rate_component_seed + n_seeds - 1

selection_status: selection-free source payload; every configured non-KLD method is reported at every directional rate and no winner is used for inference

statistics.bh_family_ownership: BH is applied within each attack-mechanism × method rate family; cells sharing design structure are not treated as independent families

byzantine.bh_family_ownership: one BH family per attack mechanism and robust method across the declared rates; no families are pooled across cells

confident_wrong.bh_family_ownership: one BH family per attack mechanism and robust method across the declared rates; no families are pooled across cells

drift.bh_family_ownership: one BH family per attack mechanism and robust method across the declared rates; no families are pooled across cells

statistics.d_equivalent_status: secondary rank-biserial-derived display transform; finite saturation sentinels are not literal million-scale effects
statistics.mde_definition: two-sided normal-approximation observed-design MDE from the seed-level contrast standard deviation

trial_structure: n_trials nested within each seed/cell; no trial is promoted to an independent world
